title: Brimstone Is A Rockier Name
description: Renames every sulfur thing to Brimstone because brimstone is sulfur but sounds cooler
body:
![A big title card showing the word "Brimstone" in large letters, with the statement "With Pirate Speak Support" below it in smaller letters](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8af8f5a9e20c8bac891733cf26e98b6640c8db63.png)

---

So apparently brimstone is like a crystallized version of sulfur. I, for one, always associate the name "sulfur" with the chemical used in labs, not the rock it's gotten from. Add onto that brimstone having stone in its name, and yeah having the rock in sulfur caves be called brimstone sounded better to me. So here's a resourcepack to do exactly that.

## Changes

So every instance of the word "Sulfur" in game has been replaced with "Brimstone". In terms of blocks:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Sulfur → Brimstone
- Sulfur Stairs → Brimstone Stairs
- Sulfur Slab → Brimstone Slab
- Sulfur Wall → Brimstone Wall
- Polished Sulfur → Polished Brimstone
- Polished Sulfur Stairs → Polished Brimstone Stairs
- Polished Sulfur Slab → Polished Brimstone Slab
- Polished Sulfur Wall → Polished Brimstone Wall
- Sulfur Bricks → Brimstone Bricks
- Sulfur Brick Stairs → Brimstone Brick Stairs
- Sulfur Brick Slab → Brimstone Brick Slab
- Sulfur Brick Wall → Brimstone Brick Wall
- Chiseled Sulfur → Chiseled Brimstone

</details>


However, some things have gotten a slightly different non-sulfur part for their new name. Those being:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Sulfur Spike → Pointed Brimstone
- Potent Sulfur → Unstable Brimstone
- Sulfur Cube → Brimstone Blob (this includes the spawn egg and bucket versions)

</details>

---
### Subtitles

Subtitles are also supported (though sadly only in the English variants because I don't know another available language). They all get the "Sulfur → Brimstone" treatment.

As an example:

![A few different subtitles to showcase that the word "sulfur" has been replaced by "Brimstone" in them as well.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b0f0820b193b1829fac1867a6d7161129f0e930c_0.webp)

---
### Pirate Speak

Just for the sake of it, pirate speak is also supported. Instead of Brimstone though, all instances of sulfur are renamed to "Fire Catchin' Rock" because pirate speak doesn't have a unique name for Sulfur at all (I tried supporting LOLcat too, but I couldn't compare to its top tier names). For the minimally changed names:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Sulfur → Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Stairs → Stairs o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Slab → Slab o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Wall → Wall o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Polished Sulfur → Good Lookin' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Polished Sulfur Stairs → Stairs o' Good Lookin' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Polished Sulfur Slab → Slab o' Good Lookin' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Polished Sulfur Wall → Wall o' Good Lookin' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Bricks → Bricks o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Brick Stairs → Brick Stairs o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Brick Slab → Brick Slab o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Brick Wall → Brick Wall o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Chiseled Sulfur → Carv'd Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Spike → Pointy Rock o' Fire Catchin' Rock

</details>

This time though, the Sulfur Cube (and its items) are the only things with a different non-sulfur part of their name. Namely:


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Sulfur Cube → Blob o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Bucket of Sulfur Cube → Pail o' Blob o' Fire Catchin' Rock
- Sulfur Cube Spawn Egg → Blob o' Fire Catchin' Rock Cackle Fruit

</details>

(by the way, pirate speak also gets updated subtitles)
